summary: Assertion.set/.reset/.new/.renew/.contain: five verbs, each registering a closure that compares the request's and response's cookies. .set checks a cookie exists with given options; .reset checks it was sent and is still present after; .new checks it's present in the response but wasn't in the request; .renew checks expires/max-age increased; .contain checks specific option values, including unsigning a signed value against every configured secret. Grouped as one rung since they share one shape (build expectations, push a comparison closure, return Assertion for chaining); each differs only in what the closure checks.
